tmPrefilled.source: The Mini Combi Fibercoated is the Mini heater with a separate water tank for added humidity. It comes with a built-in aroma cup for essential oils and fragrances to infuse the steam generated during a sauna session. The Fibercoated model offers added safety with its cool-to-touch fibercoating to minimize risk of burns.
